name: obsidian-voice-context
description: Obsidian plugin: record without a modal, continue earlier recordings, and summarize with selected notes and links as context.

scripts.bundle: bun build src/main.ts --outfile main.js --format cjs --target node --minify --external obsidian --external electron
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.deploy: bun run bundle && if [ -z "$VAULT" ]; then echo 'VAULT is not set; skipping deploy'; else mkdir -p "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/voice-context" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/voice-context/" && echo "deployed to $VAULT"; fi
